content.title: Hope Bancorp (HOPE) Q4 2025 Earnings Transcript
content.summary: Kevin Kim: Thank you, Maxime.  Quarter-over-quarter, net income rose 12% from $31 million in the third quarter, driven by growth in net interest income, strength in customer fee income, lower provision for credit losses, and a lower tax expense, partially offset by higher operating expense.  Looking back at the year as a whole, we significantly lowered our cost of deposits, reduced our reliance on broker deposits, enhanced our earning assets mix, added experienced senior leadership and talent to support our revenue-generating capabilities, and strengthened our asset quality with a steady decrease in criticized loans in each quarter of 2025.
